name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.1
body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.
- **Fewer frozen images on Adreno 6xx** ([#170](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/170)). Some Turnip builds return early from an unlimited GPU wait; the game now waits again instead of reusing buffers the GPU is still drawing. If the GPU driver stops responding, the game explains that and closes instead of freezing the image while audio continues. Choose another driver in the launcher if this happens.
- A saved **Adreno 8xx Experimental** choice from 0.5.3 opens as the new **Adreno 8xx** driver.

## Audio

- **Audio presets are back** ([#171](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/171)). 0.6.0 was built without the 0.5.3 audio work. The launcher's **Audio** section again offers **Default**, **AYN** for handhelds that start without sound, and the experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** profile, together with the 0.5.3 audio-clock and Bluetooth/background recovery improvements.

## Installation

- **DLC imports with a title update included** ([#166](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/166)). When the game is already installed, a title update or game dump staged next to the DLC is ignored and the DLC packs are installed. If a DLC import still fails, the app shows the error, removes the staged copies and starts the installed game; previously every launch failed until `to_install` was cleared by hand.

## Launcher and touch controls

- **Resize individual controls** ([#169](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/169)). In the layout editor, tap a control and use **-** / **+** to change only its size; tap empty space to resize the whole set as before.
- **Fixed opening the layout editor while a game was running in the background.** The editor did not appear, and the leftover request opened the editor instead of the game on the next launch.
- **Redesigned launcher.** A dark, landscape screen keeps the game status, the selected driver and audio preset, **Launch game** and quick **Controls / Mods / Files** buttons on the left, with settings grouped into sections on the right. Update checks show a banner, and a new **Exit** action also closes a game left running in the background. The launcher and mod screens run full screen, in landscape and under the display cutout, and the app identifies itself to Android as a game. These parts follow **vladector**'s launcher proposal ([PR #154](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/pull/154)).

Thanks to **vladector** for the launcher proposal, and to everyone who reported the DLC, audio, Adreno 650 and touch-control problems.

name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).
- Extended landscape gameplay into the display-cutout area (PR #153 fix by [vladector](https://github.com/vladector)).
- Fixed fresh-clone builds by restoring zstd's CMake sources and executable permissions on build tools (PR #159).

name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

- Added **ISO / update / DLC packages** as a game-install source. Select the base game, title update and optional DLC files together, then launch once to verify and install them.
- A failed install is rolled back and retains the staged packages for retry; successful staging is cleaned up.
- Based on PR #78 by GdGohan, with launcher integration and corrected error handling.

### Adreno 725 experimental performance driver

- Added **A725 Performance (experimental; sysmem+nobin)** as a non-default driver option.
- Selecting it automatically forces its required Sysmem mode and exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin` preset.
- This driver is for Adreno 725 testing. Adreno 732 support is not enabled yet, and the default driver remains unchanged.

### Performance fix

- Removed accidentally enabled always-on GPU `PERF` instrumentation from 0.5.1. It added per-frame timing-query and logging overhead and was not meant for a public build.
- Corrected the log banner to `ANDROID_BUILD_ID=0.5.2-release`.

### Changes carried forward from 0.5.1

#### Achievements

- Fixed achievement-unlock notifications not appearing on Android (issue #65).

#### Touch controls

- Added an optional 8-way D-pad for gameplay (issue #68), also used on results and level-up screens.
- Cutscenes and the attract movie collapse the overlay to a single **SKIP** button, moved to the top-right to avoid subtitles and achievement notifications.
- Increased the default spacing between A/B/X/Y.

#### In-game settings

- Moved touch-control, camera and left-stick settings to the in-game **Input** menu.
- Moved FPS and profiler toggles to the in-game **Video** menu.
- Graphics driver, Mods and Debug launcher sections are collapsed by default.

#### Mods and saves

- Added the **Codes** section for built-in patches such as Homing Attack on Jump, Save Score at Checkpoints and Skip Intro Logos.
- Added **Open saves folder** and a dedicated saves root in Android's file picker.

#### Graphics and localisation

- Added experimental **Force native BC textures** for devices with native BC support that incorrectly fall back to ETC2 (issue #72). Do not enable it on Adreno/Turnip.
- Completed launcher and app UI translations for all supported languages.

Full history is available in `CHANGELOG.md`.

name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.1 [REVOKED]
body:
> [!WARNING]
> This APK has been withdrawn. Install [version 0.5.2](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/releases/tag/v0.5.2) instead.

Version 0.5.1 unintentionally shipped with always-on GPU performance instrumentation that added per-frame timing-query and logging overhead. Its APK asset was removed to prevent further installations.

All legitimate 0.5.1 changes and its full changelog are preserved in the 0.5.2 release and in `CHANGELOG.md`. The tag and this release page remain available for project history.
